system.boundary: Build a Simscape aircraft environmental-control system for a ground-to-cruise-to-ground mission.
engineering_objects: The physical moist-air path must take hot pressurized engine bleed air through ozone removal and an air-cycle cooling and dehumidification plant with heat exchangers, compressor and turbine, then deliver conditioned air to a finite cabin volume.
Include a hot-air trim or bypass path and a physical cabin outflow path.
Cabin relative humidity and ozone concentration must arise from the physical moist-air and trace-gas paths;
physical_paths: The physical moist-air path must take hot pressurized engine bleed air through ozone removal and an air-cycle cooling and dehumidification plant with heat exchangers, compressor and turbine, then deliver conditioned air to a finite cabin volume.
The cabin measurements must close the temperature and pressure loops through physical valves and the air-cycle plant.
Include a hot-air trim or bypass path and a physical cabin outflow path.
Cabin relative humidity and ozone concentration must arise from the physical moist-air and trace-gas paths;
functional_paths: Build a Simscape aircraft environmental-control system for a ground-to-cruise-to-ground mission.
Regulate cabin temperature near 22 degC and maintain cabin pressure at or above 80 kPa during low-pressure cruise.
information_paths: PassengerCount, EquipmentHeat_W, BleedPressure_kPa, BleedTemperature_degC, OzoneRemovalFraction -> F90-XTHERM-09 plant/control path -> cabin_pressure, atmospheric_pressure, cabin_temperature, atmospheric_temperature, cabin_relative_humidity, atmospheric_relative_humidity, cabin_ozone_ppm, atmospheric_ozone_ppm, acm_mass_flow, turbine_outlet_temperature, flow_valve_area, bypass_valve_area, trim_valve_area, outflow_valve_area
modes_and_events: F90-XTHERM-09 startup and continuous operation follow the current public task contract.
